16:9, cinematic hyper-realistic, 8K ultra HD, eye-level medium full shot, the ruins of Chang'an's Zhuque Avenue, collapsed stone walls, broken wooden beams, overgrown withered weeds, scattered debris and shattered tiles on the ground, fine dust suspended in cold gray air, desolate cold natural light,
Du Fu's complete image: middle-aged male, sallow and gaunt face, prominent cheekbones, deep sunken eyes with weary sorrow, graying temples, sparse messy black hair streaked with white, thin long face with unkempt beard, wearing a worn-out gray-white coarse cloth Tang-style round-collar robe full of messy wrinkles, frayed and threadbare at cuffs and hem, faded fabric, thin and slightly hunched figure,
Du Fu walks slowly through the ruins, arms hanging naturally at his sides, head slightly lowered, gaze fixed downward at the ground, left foot mid-step forward, right foot trailing, robe hem dragging slightly on dusty ground, expression heavy with grief, lips slightly parted, stable face without distortion, natural body posture, no flickering, sound effects of wind and distant crows, no background music, no subtitles.
